880-### MCPJam platform budget

884:The shared free allowance is exhausted or temporarily paused. This limit applies across free usage, not just your account, so
it can appear even when your own allowance is untouched.
886-**Next steps**
888-* Wait until the reset time shown in the error, if one is present.
889:* Use purchased credits, or add your own API key under **Settings → LLM Providers** for chat.

998-## Organization provider refusals
1000-These codes mean an AI request was refused because it could not run on one of
1001-the organization's own model providers. None of them count against MCPJam
1002:credits.
1004-Most are configuration: the request won't run until someone changes its model
1005-or the organization's providers, so trying again doesn't help. Two are
1006-temporary: `org/key_policy_unavailable` (MCPJam couldn't read the
